## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Orlando, United States. It starts at 8387 International Drive.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Experience fame like never before, as you step into the hottest celebrity party in Orlando at Madame Tussauds. Star in Bad Bunny’s next music video, step onto a hot set with Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson, and drink champagne with Ariana Grande.
>
> Plus, the Justice League need your help to save the city! Harness the power of the sea with Aquaman, show off your speed with the Flash, and lift a real helicopter with Superman! Step onto the red carpet and get the ultimate selfie with your favorite celebs at the World’s Greatest Wax Museum!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €31.36. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 14 ratings and 10 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
